sources.title: Pro Clubs Builder – FC 27 build planner (community, not affiliated with EA)
Pitch Notes – The Grounds & Clubs Deep Dive

levelCap.note: Season 2 raised the cap from 40 to 55 on 22 October, per the community builder at proclubsbuilder.co.uk. Not confirmed in an EA source.

rules.text: Every archetype is unlocked from the start; progression (AXP) is per archetype.
Archetype resets no longer cost coins or a reset consumable.
Amps are temporary boosts for the active archetype (tiers 1–4, higher tiers add PlayStyles/PlayStyles+ and perks). At launch, Amps give no PlayStyle+.
AXP consumables can have their own level caps, always within the global max level.

EA lists Masteries (small permanent boosts per archetype level, e.g. Finisher level 10: +1 Finishing, +1 Composure). The community builder this ruleset follows does not apply them, so they are not added to attribute values here.
Season 2 raised the level cap from 40 to 55 (22 October). Levels 41 to 55 give 25 AP each, with milestone levels of 44, 63 and 50 AP.
Skill Moves and Weak Foot stars cost AP and are limited per archetype (e.g. a Finisher goes 3 to 5 stars, a Boss has at most 3 Skill Moves).

Height and weight change Acceleration, Agility, Balance, Jumping, Sprint Speed and Strength by up to 3 per factor, relative to the middle of the archetype's allowed size range. The result is capped at 99, not at the archetype ceiling.

Facilities have three star levels, are paid from a K budget that grows with your level (1100 K + 50 K per level above 1), and boost two attributes each. Boosts add to attribute values without costing AP.
